rooms.name: International Conference Hall (Golden Room)
rooms.note: 2F. Simultaneous interpretation equipment available. 110 fixed seats on the 2F.

ops.prevDaySetup: Setup and cleanup time on the day before and the day of the meeting is counted in the usage fee calculation. Luggage for the meeting is accepted from the day before; the organizer contacts the staff in charge in advance and sends it to the Keidanren Kaikan Sales Center, stating the date of use and the organizer's name. When simultaneous interpretation equipment is used, the room is booked from 2 hours before the start; for meetings involving video, the room is booked including the time needed for rehearsals and the like (revised April 1, 2026). (Source: Guide to Use)
ops.vehicleRules: When luggage is brought in or out by car, contact the staff in charge in advance. There is a loading area on the B2F, free if the vehicle leaves within 30 minutes (may be crowded). Items that cannot be carried in by the freight elevator will be refused (revised April 1, 2026). (Source: Guide to Use)
ops.parking: The shared parking lot on the B2F can be used at 300 yen per 30 minutes per vehicle (tax included), paid in cash at the exit. Large vehicles such as buses and trucks cannot park (revised April 1, 2026). (Source: Guide to Use)
ops.catering: Use of the meeting rooms is booked together with food or drinks. Operation is entrusted to Palace Hotel; food and drinks are provided by the venue, and bringing in outside food or drinks is strictly prohibited. During meeting hours, use in principle comes with a reservation for a cake set (cake and coffee or tea). Meal hours are 12:00-14:00 and 18:00-21:00, and use that includes these hours is accepted together with a meal reservation. Sample menus (tax included; prices revised September 1, 2026): party 8,800 yen and 11,000 yen, formal course meal 7,700 yen, 9,900 yen and 14,300 yen, boxed lunch from 6,050 yen (lunch), kaiseki 14,850 yen. The menu must be specified by 5 business days before. (Source: Food and Drink Guide)
